source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer H1 2026 interim statement (Nestle Nigeria Plc unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, filed on NGX): Revenue 650,759,475,000; Cost of Sales 392,238,873,000; Gross Profit 258,520,603,000; Operating Profit (EBIT) 141,363,719,000 (printed as Results from operating activities); Net Finance Costs 14,595,641,000 (finance costs 47.86bn less finance income 33.26bn); Profit Before Tax 126,768,078,000; Income Tax 61,991,246,000 (Profit Before Tax less Net Profit); Net Profit 64,776,832,000; EPS 81.72. UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
